lines: Keep this link — it IS your access: anyone with it acts as you. It opens your view of this session: your registration, the rooms, and (if you adjudicate) the ballot.

blocks.text: GET /l/:code signs the browser in as the guest — only an anonymous browser or another guest identity adopts it; a signed-in account is offered the claim instead (user column). If Olena leaves or the head removes her, the link dies and her name is deleted.
